about: 课件 practice page, read by slides.mjs. q / a / why = [中文, English]; scene = the video scene that asks it; run = the command it quotes (data/runs.sh); reasoned = true when only arithmetic or reasoning backs it.

q: 驱动器在新目标到达时动作，主站尽量每 1 毫秒发一次。实际周期会偏离 1 毫秒多少？
The drives act when new targets arrive, and the master tries to send every 1 ms. How far from 1 ms do the real cycles land?
a: 大多数在 1 毫秒附近，但标准差有几十微秒，总有周期早到或晚到几百微秒，偶尔还会晚到几毫秒（macOS 调度的停顿）。J1 和 J2 之间却每个周期都只差 310 纳秒。

Most stay near 1 ms, but the spread is tens of microseconds, some cycles come hundreds of microseconds early or late, and now and then one is milliseconds late (a macOS scheduling stall). Yet J1 and J2 are only 310 ns apart in every cycle.
why: 三次真实运行，每次约 2500 个周期，data.py 逐条检查这些性质。310 纳秒是模拟的网线（5 ns）加芯片处理（305 ns，取自 ET1100 数据手册）延迟。
Three real runs of about 2,500 cycles each; data.py checks each property. The 310 ns is the simulated cable (5 ns) plus chip processing delay (305 ns, from the ET1100 datasheet).

q: 一个关节每秒转 90°，某个周期晚到了 0.3 毫秒。它落后了多少度？
A joint turns at 90° per second. One cycle arrives 0.3 ms late. How far behind is it, in degrees?
why: 误差 = 速度 × 晚了多久。先把毫秒换成秒。
Error = speed × lateness. Convert ms to s first.

q: 机床以 F3000 进给，主站抖动 50 微秒。位置误差大约是多少？
A machine tool feeds at F3000 and the master jitters by 50 µs. Roughly what position error is that?
why: F 值的单位是毫米每分钟，先除以 60 换成每秒。
The F value is in mm per minute: divide by 60 to get per second.

q: 三个驱动器收到同一条广播就动作，但广播在 1.0、2.1、2.9 毫秒时发出。这是偏差还是抖动？
Three drives act on one broadcast, but the broadcasts leave at 1.0, 2.1 and 2.9 ms. Is that skew or jitter?
a: 抖动。三个驱动器彼此一致（没有偏差），但节拍本身是 1.1 毫秒、0.8 毫秒，不是 1 毫秒。
Jitter. The three drives agree with each other (no skew), but the beat itself is 1.1 ms, then 0.8 ms, not 1 ms.
why: 偏差是同一周期里关节之间的时刻差；抖动是周期本身的长短在变。
Skew is the time difference between joints within one cycle; jitter is the cycle length itself changing.

q: 用了分布式时钟以后，主站发送仍然晃几十微秒。为什么这些晃动传不到关节？
With distributed clocks, the master's sending still wobbles by tens of microseconds. Why doesn't that wobble reach the joints?
a: 关节不再在帧到达时动作，而是在自己时钟产生的 SYNC0 时刻动作。帧只要在 SYNC0 之前到就行。真实运行里驱动器的周期离散约 5 纳秒。前提是帧真的提前到了；晚于 SYNC0 会怎样，第 5 集再讲。

The joints no longer act when a frame arrives; they act on SYNC0 from their own clocks. The frame only has to arrive before SYNC0. In the real run the drives' period spread is about 5 ns. That assumes the frame does arrive first; what happens if it is late is Episode 5.
why: 同一条虚拟总线、同一台 Mac，只把驱动器改成按 SYNC0 动作；三次运行周期离散都约 5 纳秒（模拟芯片）。
Same virtual line, same Mac, only the drives switched to act on SYNC0; all three runs show about 5 ns period spread (simulated chips).
